<th class="th" colspan="1">12 Months Ended</th>

<tr><th class="th"><div>Dec. 31, 2025</div></th></tr>
<tr class="re">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_LEEF_DisclosureContingentConsiderationAndConsiderationPayableAbstract', window );"><strong>Contingent Consideration And Consideration Payable</strong></a></td>
<td class="text">&#160;<span></span>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl custom" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_LEEF_ContingentConsiderationAndConsiderationPayableTextBlock', window );">Contingent Consideration and Consideration Payable</a></td>
<td class="text"><p id="xdx_80D_ecustom--ContingentConsiderationAndConsiderationPayableTextBlock_z4nxFhwDEjz7" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; display: none; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; font-size: 10pt">
  <tr style="vertical-align: top">
    <td style="width: 24px"><span style="font-size: 10pt"><b>15.</b></span></td>
    <td style="text-align: justify"><span style="font-size: 10pt"><b><span id="xdx_822_zPzUVbCCOVgd">Contingent Consideration and Consideration Payable</span></b></span></td></tr>
  </table>
<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In October 2021, the Company entered into a Membership
Interest Unit Purchase Agreement with Anderson Development SB, LLC (&#8220;ADSB&#8221;) to acquire <span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionPercentageOfVotingInterestsAcquired_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20211031__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--AndersonDevelopmentSBLLCMember_zCmu5yaIXZQ3">100</span>% of the outstanding membership
interest units. As consideration for the interest units, the Company agreed to an Earnout Consideration (&#8220;Earnout&#8221;) in the
amount equal to <span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--EquityMethodInvestmentOwnershipPercentage_iI_dp_c20211031__srt--ScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentEquityMethodInvesteeNameAxis__custom--AndersonDevelopmentSBLLCMember_zNpGqX889uji" title="Investment amount percentage">200</span>% of the investment amount in ADSB. The Earnout shall be contingent upon ADSB successfully obtaining a land use permit
and a business license to conduct cannabis cultivation by February 28, 2025. As of December 31, 2021 there was a remote probability of
this occurring before the Earnout Deadline. During the year ended December 31, 2022, Management determined it became highly probable
ADSB would acquire the permit and license within the allotted time. This was based on a large change and turnaround in the cultivation
market during the year ended December 31, 2022. As such, the Company recorded an additional contingent consideration for the Earnout
that will be paid out totaling $<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationAsset_iI_c20221231_zIxYLegfE6fe" title="Additional contingent consideration">2,400,000</span>.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></p>



<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Pursuant to the terms of the merger agreement,
former LEEF shareholders will also be entitled to receive the following contingent Earn-out Payments, On July 20, 2023, an amount equal
to <span id="xdx_90C_ecustom--EarnOutPaymentsPercentage_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20230720_zF0SAMKGW2Kh" title="Earn-out payments percentage">10</span>% of (A) the product equal to two times the TTM revenue calculated for the 12-month period immediately following closing minus (B)
$<span id="xdx_90E_ecustom--EarnoutPayment_iI_pn6n6_c20230720_zWLbg6EexYei" title="Earnout payment">120</span> million; on July 20, 2024, an amount equal to <span id="xdx_909_ecustom--EarnOutPaymentsPercentage_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20240720_zIWvi9q1Gwsb" title="Earn-out payments percentage">10</span>% of (A) the product equal to two times the TTM revenue calculated for the 12-month
period immediately following the date that is one year from the closing date minus (B) the $<span id="xdx_902_ecustom--EarnoutPayment_iI_pn6n6_c20240720_zVDlRwOWMJqa" title="Earnout payment">120</span> million and minus (C) any amounts paid
pursuant to the First Earn-Out Payment; and on July 20, 2025, an amount equal to <span id="xdx_907_ecustom--EarnOutPaymentsPercentage_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20250720_zIc0T4lxubM3" title="Earn-out payments percentage">10</span>% of (A) the product equal to two times the TTM revenue
calculated for the 12-month period immediately following the date that is two years from the closing date minus (B) $<span id="xdx_900_ecustom--EarnoutPayment_iI_pn6n6_c20250720_zUaR7tv0jCN2" title="Earnout payment">120</span> million, minus
(C) any amounts paid pursuant to the First Earn-Out Payment, minus (D) any amounts paid pursuant to the Second Earn-Out Payment. The
original value of the total earnout as of April 20, 2022 was $<span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionCostOfAcquiredEntityTransactionCosts_iI_c20220420_zQPUUYea5vec">3,972,000</span>. Each of the Earn-Out Payments will be satisfied in full through
the issuance of common shares of the Company based on the 30-day volume weighted average trading price of the shares on the Canadian
Securities Exchange for the period ending on the business day prior to the issuance.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">By the beginning of 2024, the contingent consideration
was $<span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferred1_c20250101__20251231_z7JntMkuXLN3">1,355,000</span>, which includes $<span id="xdx_904_ecustom--EarnoutPaymentsNonCurrent_iI_c20251231_zZTCEjPLkp1f" title="Earn-out payments non-current">855,000</span> related to the Earn Out Payments and classified as a long term liability and $<span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationLiabilityCurrent_iI_c20250930_zTlQ6wMh7UYf">500,000</span> related
to ADSB, which is classified as a current liability. As of December 31, 2024, the $<span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferred1_c20240101__20241231_ziOmQ4hHHEjc">855,000</span> in contingent consideration related to the
Earn Out Payments was released, leaving a balance of $<span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationLiabilityCurrent_iI_c20241231_zENiclmit9Ql">500,000</span> outstanding. During the year ended December 31, 2025, payments related
to ADSB totaling $<span id="xdx_906_ecustom--BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferred_c20250101__20251231_z4DLTXEHMnGh" title="Business combination consideration transferred">160,000</span> were made, leaving a balance of $<span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationLiabilityCurrent_iI_c20251231_z1a0SRcEi40g">340,000</span> outstanding as of December 31, 2025.</p>

<span></span>
</td>
</tr>
